interventions.hypothesis: High-confidence operation controls must be consumed by typed operation semantics rather than treated as payload or silently ignored.
interventions.stage1_evidence: 22 materialization-bound cases whose first blocker involved source field 'operation'

interventions.hypothesis: Explicit group-local conflict semantics in the request must not be degraded to needs_clarification or a contradictory action/target.
Explicit requested update columns define a closed update set and must survive planning/materialization without omission, silent unknown-column loss, or contradiction with exclusions.
interventions.stage1_evidence: 4 executed-but-wrong update-column omission cases plus latent relationship-column expansion cases

interventions.hypothesis: Explicit row boundaries and conservative textual-null semantics prevent deterministic source-parser row collapse, control-row fabrication, and TEXT-to-NULL corruption.

A free-text cell whose reference plan explicitly requests date normalization can be normalized safely only when its verbatim evidence is a strict, unambiguous year-first DATE/DATETIME; unsupported or ambiguous temporal surfaces must fail closed and retain raw-span provenance.
interventions.stage1_evidence: 9 DATE_NORMALIZATION_POLICY_ERROR + 1 DATE_NORMALIZATION_AND_EVIDENCE_SPAN_ERROR; manual audit found 12 valid explicit datetime values rejected by iso_date_normalization and two wrong non-date evidence values (Attempt/For) that must remain rejected.

interventions.hypothesis: A non-empty reference that has already failed a deterministic reference boundary may be repaired safely only from its slot-local closed valid set when one candidate is uniquely determined by an exact identifier-name anchor or by a singleton valid set; semantic evidence/conflict/update choices remain protected and all other cases fail closed.
interventions.stage1_evidence: 35 Stage-1 first failures at reference resolution (28 REF_UNKNOWN_COLUMN + 7 REF_INVALID_SOURCE_REF), manually classified under the final F eligibility whitelist as 13 reference-only repairable, 10 reference-repair-partial-but-sample-not-safe, and 12 non-repairable; diagnostic/regression evidence only.

interventions.hypothesis: Under the conservative G1 boundary policy, a selected identifier evidence span with one terminal period or comma may be replaced only by the unique pre-enumerated candidate at the same start and end-minus-one boundary; this does not independently prove the punctuation is linguistically incorrect. The plan is deep-copied, only value_from changes, and the frozen boundary is retried once.
interventions.stage1_evidence: One manually audited Stage-1 case, final_archeology_032, selected e3='SC9081.' while the frozen candidate set also contained e7='SC9081' at the exact bounded span; diagnostic/regression evidence only.
interventions.compatibility_note: Comma remains a reserved compatibility branch in the frozen G1 config; no observed Stage-1 fixture or dedicated regression activates it.

interventions.hypothesis: When frozen Stage E rejects a non-temporal evidence reference with TEMPORAL_EVIDENCE_TYPE_MISMATCH for one iso_date_normalization slot, G2 may replace only that value_from when both the rejected evidence and replacement preserve the diagnosed effective target under the frozen exact-column grounding rule, and exactly one compatible maximal primary DATE/DATETIME candidate remains after the forward same-sentence filters.
interventions.stage1_evidence: Two manually audited temporal Stage-1 cases (final_vaccine_002 and final_vaccine_048) are eligible diagnostic/regression fixtures; final_virtual_046 is retained as a non-temporal out-of-scope control. No end-to-end rescue claim is made.
